resources.string: When enabled, your request, recent conversation context and candidate routes are sent to the configured provider to judge intent and choose routes. If it fails, Mika uses the existing model. Main, vision and light model settings stay separate.
Enter the complete SystemOne endpoint URL. HTTPS is required except for local HTTP services. The API key is stored encrypted on this device.
Enter a valid endpoint and model ID. Enabling or testing also requires an API key.
Save to apply the switch and connection settings to new tasks.
Testing sends only a fixed greeting and two choices to this endpoint. It does not send your conversations, screens or memories, save changes, or enable the service.
Connection works; the synthetic choice was correct.
Test failed. Check the endpoint, model, API key and network.
Saved. New tasks will use these settings.
Could not save. Your previous saved settings are unchanged.
